title: (fix) O3-6093: Improve support for arrow functions in expression variable extractor

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

There were several edge-cases in the expression-extractor where unbound variables defined in arrow functions (e.g., the `x` in `() => !x`) weren't properly captured. This PR fixes this and adds a number of regression tests.
